name: Galata Wind Enerji A.S.
summary: Galata Wind Enerji A.S., together with its subsidiaries, engages in generation and sale of electricity from renewable energy in Turkey. The company operates three wind power plants and three solar power plants with a total capacity of approximately 297.2 MW. It also installs systems for the generation of energy from solar radiation; constructs, commissions, and leases facilities for the generation of electrical energy; and develops projects in Europe. The company was formerly known as GY Enerji Danismanlik Poje Muhendislik Uretim, Ticaret ve Sanayi Limited Sirketi and changed its name to Galata Wind Enerji A.S. in January 2012.
